mapper.sql: USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, USER_NAME, POSITION_NAME, DEPT_NAME, ROLE, ENABLED_YN, FAILED_COUNT, LAST_LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT, NVL(REVENUE_YN, 'N') AS REVENUE_YN, NVL(WELFARE_YN, 'N') AS WELFARE_YN, NVL(RECORDS_MANAGER_YN, 'N') AS RECORDS_MANAGER_YN, EMP_NO, JOB_SERIES, HIRED_ON, EXTENSION
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USER_ACCOUNT ORDER BY DEPT_NAME NULLS LAST, USER_NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET FAILED_COUNT = FAILED_COUNT + 1 WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET FAILED_COUNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN_AT = #{now} WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET FAILED_COUNT = 0 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT = #{changedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET ENABLED_YN = #{enabledYn} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET WELFARE_YN = #{welfareYn} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET RECORDS_MANAGER_YN = #{yn} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET REVENUE_YN = #{revenueYn} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ACCOUNT SET DEPT_NAME = #{deptName} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_DEPT_HISTORY (HISTORY_ID, USER_ID, FROM_DEPT, TO_DEPT, MOVED_AT, MOVED_BY) VALUES (SEQ_USER_DEPT_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{fromDept}, #{toDept}, #{movedAt}, #{movedBy})
